prompts.room: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: background for an interactive nostalgic personal mini-room webpage, original detailed 16-bit pixel art. A cozy dessert-themed cutaway room in a shallow isometric three-quarter view, wide 8:5 canvas. Two walls meet at the upper middle, cream walls with subtle strawberry wallpaper accents, a large arched window with soft sky, tiny hanging star garland. Empty honey-colored waffle parquet floor takes the middle and lower 60% of the picture, a clear diamond-shaped floor with corners approximately (8%,56%), (49%,34%), (94%,56%), (50%,94%). Plenty of quiet clear space for furniture and a tiny character to be added in code. Soft pink, butter yellow, mint and lavender, warm afternoon daylight, crisp hand-pixelled clusters. Original personal-room aesthetic. NO characters, furniture on the floor, text, UI, logos, borders or watermarks. Do not depict an existing app or copy its branding.
prompts.furniture: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite atlas of six dessert-themed furniture items for a cozy isometric personal pixel room. EXACT 3 equal columns and 2 equal rows, six clearly separated isolated assets at matching scale, each contained in its cell with generous transparent padding. ROW 1 left: pink strawberry cake sofa with soft cream cushions, middle: round cupcake coffee table with a cream top and a small coffee cup, right: cookie-shaped armchair with chocolate chip cushion. ROW 2 left: mint dessert bookshelf filled with pastel books and a few macarons, middle: small strawberry potted plant in a cream teacup pot, right: peach tea cart with two stacked macarons and a teapot. Shallow three-quarter isometric front view matching a cutaway waffle-floor room. Detailed crisp hand-pixelled 16-bit art, soft outlines, warm highlights, cream pink mint lavender palette, readable toy-like silhouettes. One object per cell, NO background, no floor, no characters, no text, no labels, no drop-shadow outside silhouettes. Genuinely transparent background. Wide 3:2 sheet.
